effect: M57.4 establishes source-bound evidence mechanics, but its direct launch surface lets one coordinator receive all role capabilities and exposes a bearer token through process arguments, browser URL/history and HTML. This does not invalidate frozen synthetic mechanics, but it is not a suitable participant handoff surface.
required_next_change: Add an external wrapper that issues three separately stored permission-restricted capability envelopes, returns no raw role token, consumes each envelope once, and exchanges it for an in-memory server-side role capability plus a host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Strict browser session and CSRF token. Do not edit M57.4 frozen evidence semantics.
claim_boundary: This probe identifies application-interface exposure. It does not show that filesystem permissions prove participant identity, that localhost HTTP has transport security, that three physical humans exist, or that any formal evidence/result is authorized.
